title: Thompson Sampling using Prior-fitted Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.14656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thompson sampling is natural randomized strategy for optimizing unknown functions in a black-box manner. In continuous global optimization, Thompson sampling has largely been restricted to Gaussian process priors, as these are essentially the only class for which computing the posterior distribution has been tractable in practice. In this work, we introduce \emph{prior-fitted diffusion transformers}, which are diffusion models that perform Thompson sampling in-context at inference time, after being pre-trained using the prior-fitted network paradigm. To apply these models, we develop a set of practical non-Gaussian priors for general black-box functions---including those that have characteristics that cannot be achieved under Gaussianity, such as priors over unimodal functions. We also quantify the tradeoff between model size and the number of pre-training iterations, and show that these models follow scaling laws akin to those observe

translated_title: 基于先验拟合扩散Transformer的汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 汤普森采样是一种以黑盒方式优化未知函数的自然随机化策略。在连续全局优化中，汤普森采样在很大程度上受限于高斯过程先验，因为高斯过程实际上是唯一一类在实践中能够可行地计算后验分布的先验类别。在这项工作中，我们提出了先验拟合扩散Transformer，这是一类在使用先验拟合网络范式进行预训练后，能够在推理阶段通过上下文学习执行汤普森采样的扩散模型。为了应用这些模型，我们为一般黑盒函数开发了一组实用的非高斯先验——包括那些具有在高斯假设下无法实现的特征的先验，例如单峰函数上的先验。我们还量化了模型大小与预训练迭代次数之间的权衡，并证明这些模型遵循与大规模模型类似的缩放定律。
tldr: 该论文提出先验拟合扩散Transformer，使扩散模型能够在推理时以上下文方式执行汤普森采样，突破了传统上仅限于高斯过程先验的限制，并引入了单峰函数等实用的非高斯先验。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces prior-fitted diffusion transformers that perform Thompson sampling in-context at inference time, overcoming the traditional restriction to Gaussian process priors and enabling practical non-Gaussian priors such as unimodal functions.
